title: Spanish i18n, Inmovel branding, light-only theme, and Indigo/purple palette
description: Configure the CRM for Spanish runtime, Inmovel brand identity, and the specified color palette. This covers: (1) setting the i18nProvider to Spanish as default (the CRM ships with English and French message files — add Spanish or use a Spanish ra-language package); (2) updating App.tsx title and logo to Inmovel; (3) applying the palette primary=#4f46e5 / secondary=#764ba2 / light=#667eea to the lightTheme prop; (4) disabling dark mode (lightTheme only, no darkTheme prop); (5) updating CRM configuration props to use Spanish labels for pipeline stages, handoff_trigger options, and other domain enums.
acceptance_criteria: src/App.tsx sets title='Inmovel CRM' and logo to the Inmovel brand mark (SVG or PNG asset added to src/assets/)
src/App.tsx passes lightTheme with primary color #4f46e5, secondary #764ba2, accent/light #667eea applied via the theme customization pattern used by shadcn-admin-kit
src/App.tsx does not pass a darkTheme prop (light-only deployment)

src/components/atomic-crm/providers/commons/ adds a spanishCrmMessages.ts file with Spanish translations for all CRM-specific UI strings (at minimum: resource names, field labels, action buttons, stage names S1..S10+Descartado)
i18nProvider is configured to use Spanish as the default locale
src/App.tsx CRM props use Spanish labels: dealStages equivalent (pipelineStages) uses 'S1 Contacto'..'S10 Cierre'+'Descartado', handoff_trigger options labeled in Spanish
The app renders Spanish UI labels at runtime without any English fallback visible to end users for core CRM strings

non_functional_requirements.performance: No measurable bundle size impact from adding Spanish messages
